attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Calder Combine maintains its five settlements are thriving.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news and adds a claim about thriving settlements the briefing does not give (only that harvests are good)"},{"span":"They claim good harvests continue along the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as an ongoing present claim, implying continuation"},{"span":"One assumes the pirates found the cargo more appealing than the Calder Combine’s reported bounty.","severity":"minor","reason":"guess framed as such, but implies the barge was Calder's; the briefing does not say whose barge it was"},{"span":"the usual low-level thievery","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a pattern of past petty theft the briefing does not give"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The first item is accurate and the dry guesses are properly framed.
